leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Initialize and manage form state across multiple steps using JavaScript objects
Implement navigation handlers to control step progression and validation
Construct validation functions for form fields and integrate them with step logic
Render dynamic form interfaces based on current step state
Bind form input events to update state and trigger validation
Control UI feedback by displaying validation errors and success messages
Integrate all form steps into a cohesive multi-step submission flow
lessonTitle: Build a multi step form with validation
